name: Yakumo (Hokkaido, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Yakumo town emblem in blue: a disc with white wave strokes and a small disc, like a stylised bird over water.
history: Municipal flag of Yakumo, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 October 2005.

features.role: Yakumo town emblem — a disc with white wave strokes and a small disc, like a stylised bird over water
